content: The TCT 2008 schedule outlines the coordination of TV events during the conference. Press conferences discussing late-breaking trials are scheduled for Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, starting at approximately 12:15 or 12:30 PM. After these press conferences, presenters and moderators will be escorted to the TCT TV studio (Room 305) for interviews and discussion sessions with Mike. Additional segmented interviews with other TCT faculty are being arranged throughout the week. Saturday, October 11, 2008 2:00 PM 5:00 PM: ALERT AMI Investigator Meeting in Room 3 at the Renaissance Hotel. 4:00 PM 5:45 PM: Interventional Scientific Council Meeting and Workgroup Breakout Session at Heart House. Sunday, October 12, 2008 12:40 PM 1:55 PM: Session on Interventional Strategies and Adjunct Pharmacology in ACS and AMI, Part I: Unstable Angina and NSTEMI. This includes a moderated roundtable discussion and audience Q&A in Room 147B. Role: Moderator. 5:12 PM 5:22 PM: ACS Session IV: Antiplatelet and Antithrombin Decisions in NSTE-ACS: Data-driven Debates. Focus on thienopyridine decisions (Clopidogrel vs. Prasugrel). Room: 147B. Role: Lecturer. 5:42 PM 5:52 PM: Continuation of ACS Session IV with a roundtable discussion and audience Q&A. Room: 147B. Role: Discussant. Monday, October 13, 2008 9:00 AM 10:00 AM: eSCAI meeting. 10:20 AM 10:30 AM: The DES Summit: Dual Anti-Platelet Use Considerations. Focus on Prasugrel as a potent newcomer to reduce stent thrombosis without increasing bleeding. Room: Ballroom C. Role: Lecturer. 10:30 AM 10:42 AM: Audience Q&A on the DES Summit topic. Room: Ballroom C. Role: Discussant. 3:15 PM 5:30 PM: TCT-TV smaller interviews with confirmed participants: G. Dangas: Topic Interruption of Dual Antiplatelet Therapy. M. Farkouh: Topic Update on the FREEDOM trial. N. Pijls: Topic The Treatment of MVD. R. Schwartz: Topic Integration of advanced imaging into interventional practice – the future. Fred Feit: Topic Future of Medical Communications. S-W Park: Topic Results of DECREASE-Registry. Z. Hijazi: Topic Structural heart disease – what's new and in the pipeline. M. Krucoff: Topic Challenges Facing New DES: Can We Tell 'Newer' from 'Better'? Tuesday, October 14, 2008 8:30 AM 9:30 AM: Breakfast meeting at the Grand Hyatt. 10:30 AM 11:00 AM: Main Arena I Plenary Session 3: PCI Controversies I. Focus on the appropriate utilization of antithrombotic and antiplatelet therapies. Room: Ballroom, Third Floor. Role: Discussant. 1:06 PM 1:11 PM: Controversies in Adjunct Pharmacology: Agenda. Focus on upstream drug initiation in ACS and its impact on clinical and angiographic outcomes. Room: 201. Role: Lecturer. 3:05 PM 3:30 PM: Exploring the Guidelines: Evidence-Based Medicine Review and Debates. Hot Topic 2: ACS Controversies. Room: 209 ABC. Role: Discussant. 5:30 PM 6:30 PM: TCT-TV smaller interviews with confirmed participants: Sid Smith: Topic TBD. Gary Mintz: Topic State of the art in ultrasound and its clinical application. Alice Jacobs: Topic American Heart Association’s STEMI initiative: Mission: Lifeline. Marty Leon: Topic TBD. Wednesday, October 15, 2008 8:40 AM 8:55 AM: Coronary Theater II: Focus on Interventional Pharmacology. Discussion on glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors and integration of the latest clinical trial results. Room: Coronary Theater, Lower Level. Role: Lecturer. 9:00 AM 10:30 AM: Late-Breaking Trials Press Conference. Room: 159A. Role: Moderator. 12:27 PM 12:30 PM: Main Arena II Plenary Session 14: First Report Randomized Trials & Registries II. Critique and clinical perspectives. Room: Ballroom, Third Level. Role: Critical Commentary. 2:30 PM 5:30 PM: TCT-TV smaller interviews with confirmed participants: Harvey White: Topic ACUITY study. Jim Hermiller: Topic Percutaneous approach to functional MR using EVOLVE. Matthew Price: Topic Clopidogrel non-responsiveness and the GRAVITAS trial. Jeff Popma: Topic CoreValve Percutaneous Aortic Valve. Mike Jaff: Topic Three major clinical challenges facing vascular specialists. Cindy Grines: Topic Late-Breaking Trials at TCT. David Holmes, Jr.: Topic AngelMed ALERT AMI trial. David Cohen: Topic Economics of drug-eluting stents and optimal duration of dual antiplatelet therapy. Thursday, October 16, 2008 9:50 AM 11:05 AM: Antithrombin Alternatives: Low Molecular Weight Heparins, Direct Antithrombins, Xa Inhibitors, and Emerging Agents. Session III: Current Antithrombin Choices for PCI. Room: 145AB. Role: Moderator. 12:30 PM 1:30 PM: TCT-TV interviews with late-breaking trial presenters. Room: 305. Confirmed participants include C.M. Gibson, D. Hildick-Smith, J. Lassen, and R. Byrne. 2:30 PM 5:00 PM: TCT-TV smaller interviews with confirmed participants: Roxana Mehran: Topic HORIZONS AMI. Gregg Stone: Topic Drug-eluting stents in AMI – the HORIZONS Trial. Renu Virmani: Topic DES and Acute Myocardial Infarction or DES and Atherosclerosis. David Antoniucci: Topic Dual non-responsiveness to aspirin and clopidogrel (RECLOSE trial). Ajay Kirtane: Topic Recap of TCT 2008. Patrick Serruys: Topic SYNTAX. Ted Feldman: Topic Current status of percutaneous mitral valve therapy or PCI for left main & 3-vessel CAD. Carlo Briguori: Topic Peri-procedural complications following stent implantation in diabetic patients, with a focus on bleeding. Interviewee Lists List 1: Includes individuals such as Bill Gray, Cindy Grines, Jim Hermiller, Jeff Popma, Matthew Price, Deepak Bhatt, Ziyad Hijazi, David Holmes, Alice Jacobs, Mike Jaff, and others. List 2: Includes Gregg Stone, Marty Leon, Friedrich W. Mohr, Patrick W.J. Pijls, Eberhard Grube, Dean Kereiakes, and others. Please review these lists and identify which individuals you would like to schedule for interviews or discussions. Once finalized, their time will be officially booked into the TCT schedule.
